use_case_name: Exchange IFF and SIF Transponder Data

claims.content: The exchange of IFF/SIF modes and codes consists of five functional areas: Surveillance Data Reporting, Unique Mode II Code Protection, Clearing IFF/SIF Data, Difference Resolution, and Update Request.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The exchange of IFF/SIF modes and codes consists of five functional areas: Surveillance Data Reporting, Unique Mode II Code Protection, Clearing IFF/SIF Data, Difference Resolution, and Update Request.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: C2 JU reports available IFF/SIF surveillance data for an Air or Surface track in the applicable J-series message/word (J3.1/J3.5 PTI=0 or J3.2C1/J3.3C1).
scope_contract.start_boundary: C2 JU has IFF/SIF surveillance data available to report for a track.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The IFF/SIF surveillance data has been reported/transmitted in the applicable J-series message/word for the track.
in_scope_actions: Reporting IFF/SIF surveillance data for Air and Surface tracks
Transmitting available IFF/SIF Modes I, II, III codes in J3.1/J3.5 (PTI=0) messages when available
Reporting IFF/SIF surveillance data in J3.2C1/J3.3C1 words for Air/Surface tracks
excluded_adjacent_actions: Comparing locally held IFF/SIF data with data reported by another JU and reporting differences
Administering IFF/SIF code assignment or configuration
Processing or displaying received IFF/SIF data after exchange
